name: Bọt Biển City #9
description:
An interactive architectural canvas from the Bọt Biển City collection. As the collector of this bespoke slot, you hold the exclusive utility to submit a reference portrait to be illustrated into this architectural space.

[Submission Terms & Guidelines]
1. Civility & Appropriateness: Submitted photos must be respectful. We strictly reject nudity, sexually explicit content, violence, hate speech, or offensive material.
2. Non-Political Standard: Strictly no political figures, party symbols, propaganda, or sensitive geopolitical themes.
3. Rights & Integrity: You must possess legal rights to the submitted image. The artist reserves creative discretion over stylization, perspective, and composition to maintain aesthetic harmony with the architecture.
4. Non-Compliance Policy: If a submission violates these terms, you will be requested to provide a replacement within 7 business days. Due to the immutable nature of blockchain transactions, purchases are non-refundable. Non-compliant submissions will remain as the original architectural artwork.
